Reweight carriage composition and define model groups

reweight_carriage.Rd

Combines child carriage counts with IPD-derived carriage estimates (child, adult and unknown-age IPD, divided by invasiveness) into a synthetic child carriage population per year, defines the model groups from the pre-vaccine composition, and builds x(t).

Usage

reweight_carriage(
  meta_clean,
  inv,
  tauA,
  tauU,
  k,
  prevax_years,
  min_sero_frac,
  min_sg_frac
)

Arguments

meta_clean

Cleaned metadata, e.g. from clean_metadata().

inv

Invasiveness lookup, e.g. from build_invasiveness_lookup().

tauA

Weight for adult IPD, should be very small.

tauU

Weight for unknown-age IPD (proportion of the dataset that is of unknown age).

k

Dirichlet prior strength: how many child carriage swabs the IPD-based estimate is worth.

prevax_years

Pre-vaccine years used to define the groups.

min_sero_frac

NVT serotypes below this share of pre-vaccine synthetic carriage go to "rare_NVT".

min_sg_frac

Serotype-GPSC pairs below this share go to "_other".

Value

A list with group_lookup, meta_clean_groups (meta_clean with a group column) and final_yearly (the synthetic carriage composition per serotype-GPSC pair, for checks).
